caveats.statement: User age may be null, so elder-user filters silently exclude those users.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab07 WHERE fld048 IS NULL

caveats.statement: View counts may be null or zero, skewing popularity comparisons.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab05 WHERE fld018 IS NULL OR fld018 = 0

caveats.statement: Bounty amounts may be null for posts without bounties.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab08 WHERE fld051 IS NULL

caveats.statement: Badge names may have duplicates across users, so counting badges requires DISTINCT user.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT fld004, COUNT(*) FROM tab01 GROUP BY fld004 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5

caveats.statement: Vote IDs may be stored as strings, so numeric comparisons can fail.
Post language tags may be stored in lowercase only, so case-sensitive filters miss uppercase variants.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT DISTINCT fld034 FROM tab06 LIMIT 20

caveats.statement: Closed status uses NULL to mean not closed, so IS NULL checks are required instead of equality.
caveats.check_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tab05 WHERE fld031 IS NULL
